peopleAlsoAsk.question: What speed should you spin your cells down at?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: For gentle pelleting of cells, lower speeds (e.g., 200-300 x g) are often used to minimize cell damage. Higher speeds (e.g., 1,000-2,000 x g) may be required for more efficient pelleting of denser cell types or larger cell aggregates.
